title.narrative: Core contribution to the Association for the Prevention of Torture (APT) 2025-2027

description.narrative: The project focuses on human rights and torture prevention and will support a wide range of activities of APT in the context of torture prevention in line with the APT's new Strategic Plan 2025-2028. The key strategic objectives are 1) ensuring effective oversight of deprivation of liberty; 2) promoting dignity and fairness within the criminal justice system; and 3) enhancing the safety and protection of those at heightened risk of torture and ill-treatment. Each annual commitment will be subject to parliamentary approval of the financial bill for the year in question.
